LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Originally released in 1988, Wasteland brought the post-apocalypse to video games and inspired a genre. Play one of history’s defining RPGs with completely overhauled graphics, sound, and expanded musical score.

The year is 2087, nearly a century after an all-out nuclear war turned vast swaths of the Earth into a radioactive hellscape. You are a Desert Ranger, a band of stalwart lawmen who are the only hope left in what was once the American southwest, and good people’s last defense against hunger, sickness, ravaging raiders, and mutants.

Now something more secretive and sinister is menacing humanity, and it's your job to investigate. Recruit help and follow leads—the choices you make will shape the world around you. Choose wisely, your life and the lives of those you’re sworn to protect depend on it.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: The RPG classic rises from the nuclear ashes! Wasteland Remastered is an overhaul of the 1988 title that brought the post-apocalypse to video games. Bring law to a lawless future or burn everything to the ground with full freedom of choice and consequence. See where the Wasteland series began and experience the character and world the sequels are built on.

Properties.PublisherCertificateName: CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US

Features: Wasteland Remastered retains the spirit of the original game while updating visuals and audio.
The original game’s physical storybook is available in-game, fully illustrated and with full voice over.
An expanded musical score from the "Wasteland 1 - The Original Classic" release.
Old bugs that have been around since Reagan was president have been fixed.
Survive the apocalypse from the comfort of your couch with full game controller support.
Quality of life improvements that make the post-apocalypse a little friendlier.
LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
PC/Windows 10
 
Added Macro function to record and replay key presses to help repeat common actions
	○ Record a macro by pressing <Ctrl> and F1-F12 to begin recording a macro to that Function key
		o Enter commands as normal during gameplay
		o Note that macros must be recording during the situation they’ll be used. i.e. Combat macros need to be recorded during combat
	○ Press <Shift> + <Esc> to stop recording
	○ You can replace or re-record a macro by using the same process
	○ If using a controller, holding the left trigger will open a radial menu allowing recording and playback of macros.
	○ Please visit the inXile forums for more detailed macro instructions.
 
Xbox One
 
Added Macro function to record and replay key presses to help repeat common actions
	○ Record a macro by pressing holding the left trigger to open a radial menu to select your macro slot
		o Enter commands as normal during gameplay
		o Note that macros must be recording during the situation they’ll be used. i.e. Combat macros need to be recorded during combat
	○ To stop recording, hold the left trigger to open the radial menu again
	○ You can replace or re-record a macro by using the same process
Please visit the inXile forums for more detailed macro instructions
